svg.title: Following a planned move with and without feedforward
svg.desc: The planned 1 rad move takes 1.5 seconds. The PID alone falls 0.092 radians behind the plan at 0.6 seconds and then overshoots the target; with the feedforward the axis stays within 0.001 radians of the plan, and on an axis with 20 percent more inertia and friction within 0.019 radians.
